metadata.description: Scientific English Agents -- competency-based AI agents for academic and scientific English in higher education (CEFR B1-C2, IMRAD, peer review, APC).

plugins.name: scientific-english-agents
plugins.description: Competency-based AI coaching for scientific/academic English: abstracts, IMRAD sections, lab reports, peer review, presentations, vocabulary, grammar, and CEFR-aligned assessment (APC). Includes an orchestrator skill (scientific-english-agents) plus 6 specialist skills, one per agent (writing-coach, critical-reviewer, lexical-expert, communication-coach, language-tutor, assessment), so a single agent can be activated on its own.
